posts.author: Random Panda
posts.body:
Hi All,
I was wondering is anyone who uses Galv's bust menu plugin has ever changed the arrows that appear when you have more characters than the main screen can show. By default it displays the up and down arrows, but as this is a column based design, right and left arrows would make more sense. But my limited coding skills have me grasping at straws trying to figure out how to do it. If anyone here has had success in changing the arrows, or can at least send me in the right direction for rewriting any part of this, it would be greatly appreciated.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
cursorLeft/cursorRight/cursorUp,cursorDown = window_base
property or window_selectable, which I think it was.
the arrow you see is from windowSkin which is in the center of
the upper right of the frame which is drawn there.
but it is added based per row or column if its larger.
I think the default is 1 column, 4 rows, so it take the arrow on the bottom.
otherwise to the right.
there is also a function to remove the arrows down/up and create
the right and left arrows, but I need to check this part, as I used the
function to empty it, so you probably need those to re-create.
I didn't see games that use galv_bust larger than 4 in a row with 1 column.
but it shouldn't be to hard to add, so I need to check how galv bustmenu
works, and find the adjustment to add correctly.
